facts.en: Completed a community administration diploma at Fictional Dewfern College in 2021.
facts.zh: 2021 年在虚构露蕨学院完成社区行政文凭课程。

facts.en: Paid reception assistant at Fictional Amberbowl Shelter from 2023-02 to 2026-08.
facts.zh: 2023-02 至 2026-08 在虚构琥珀碗动物收容所任有薪接待助理。

facts.en: Recorded reported animal names, finder statements and arrival times on intake forms.
facts.zh: 在接收表中记录报称的动物名字、发现者陈述及到达时间。

facts.en: Kept finder-reported ownership information separate from staff-verified identity checks.
facts.zh: 将发现者所述的归属信息与工作人员核实的身份查验分开记录。

facts.en: Booked intake appointments within capacity limits supplied by the shelter manager.
facts.zh: 在收容所经理提供的容量限制内安排接收预约。

facts.en: Arranged collection windows for approved foster placements after the foster coordinator confirmed the placement.
facts.zh: 在寄养协调员确认获批寄养安排后，安排接走动物的时间窗口。

facts.en: Sent foster handover packs containing the care notes approved by shelter staff.
facts.zh: 发送寄养交接资料包，其中包含收容所工作人员批准的照护备注。

facts.en: Passed health concerns raised during calls to the shelter veterinary team without giving treatment advice.
facts.zh: 将来电提出的健康问题转交收容所兽医团队，不提供治疗建议。

facts.en: Used role-limited folders for finder contact forms and removed contact details from public adoption summaries.
facts.zh: 将发现者联系表存于按岗位限制访问的文件夹，并从公开领养简介中移除联系方式。

facts.en: Helped revise the foster handover form in 2025-03 with the foster coordinator.
facts.zh: 2025-03 与寄养协调员共同协助修订寄养交接表。

facts.en: Personally added a received-by field and an unchecked-items list; the coordinator wrote the care-content sections.
facts.zh: 个人添加接收人字段及未核对事项清单；照护内容部分由协调员撰写。

facts.en: In a 2025-04 filing check, 22 of 24 sampled handover packs contained a signed receipt.
facts.zh: 2025-04 归档检查中，24 份抽样交接资料包有 22 份包含已签收凭证。

facts.en: Uses appointment calendars, spreadsheet filters and approved plain-language message templates.
facts.zh: 使用预约日历、电子表格筛选及获批的简明文字消息模板。

facts.en: Completed the shelter’s internal data-handling induction in 2023-02.
facts.zh: 2023-02 完成收容所内部数据处理入职培训。

facts.en: Before the paid role, volunteered at Fictional Basketcloud Reuse Shop from 2022-04 to 2022-10, sorting donated towels.
facts.zh: 在有薪岗位之前，2022-04 至 2022-10 在虚构篮云再利用商店做志愿者，整理捐赠毛巾。

facts.en: Prepared sign-in sheets and answered routine paperwork questions at foster orientations led by the coordinator.
facts.zh: 在协调员主持的寄养说明会上准备签到表，并回答常规资料填写问题。

facts.en: Created a personal illustrated pet-supply packing list in 2024 using invented examples.
facts.zh: 2024 年使用虚构示例制作个人图解宠物用品打包清单。

facts.en: Enjoys sewing small fabric storage pouches.
facts.zh: 爱好缝制小布收纳袋。

facts.en: The recorded shelter rota covered Tuesday through Saturday daytime shifts.
facts.zh: 记录中的收容所排班涵盖星期二至星期六的日间班次。

facts.en: Future Sunday-shift availability is not stated in the supplied records.
facts.zh: 所提供记录未说明未来星期日班次的可工作情况。
